implementation_summary: Reworked AIComputeAdapter420 from AI-AUDIT-3 graph-only binding into a narrow adapter over the current ComputeMarket signed-request, canonical job, accepted priced-match, provider, verified-entitlement, settlement and refund evidence authorities.

Bound AI request semantics to a deterministic AI-to-CMP manifest containing model version, compute requirement, privacy policy, verification profile, workload, input/output commitments, narrowed spend ceiling and narrowed deadline.
Bound deployment and AI-provider identities to the exact accepted CMP offer and compute-provider identity through AIProviderRegistry.computeProviderRef.
Bound accepted CMP resource, payer, canonical provider-derived beneficiary and accepted price, rejecting broadened or contradictory terms.
Synchronized canonical CMP running/result/verified evidence into the constrained AIJobManager lifecycle without creating duplicate compute economics or result authority.
Observed canonical CMP settlement and refund references while intentionally deferring compatibility escrow/custody reconciliation to AI-AUDIT-5.
requirements_satisfied: AI requests bind to current CMP signed request and canonical job evidence.
Adaptation narrows and cannot broaden requester-authorized spend or deadline.

Privacy policy, verification profile, compute requirement, deployment/provider constraint, workload and input/output commitments are cryptographically included in the deterministic adaptation manifest.
Accepted CMP provider/resource identity must match the bound AI deployment/provider relation.
Accepted price is bounded by the narrowed request maximum; payer and provider-derived beneficiary are frozen from current CMP evidence.
Canonical CMP result commitment and verification reference are bound without fabricating an alternate result.
Verified entitlement must match request, match, result, verifier, payer, provider, resource, beneficiary and accepted economic ceiling.
Canonical settlement and original-payer refund references are bound as evidence.
Targeted end-to-end AI -> CMP -> verified entitlement/settlement and failed-job refund evidence tests are committed.
security_adversarial_invariant_results: Broadened spend or contradictory manifest binding fails closed.
Wrong accepted provider or beneficiary fails closed.
AI adapter status progression rejects unrelated terminal CMP enum values rather than relying on enum ordering.
Provider, resource, payer, beneficiary and accepted price are derived from accepted canonical CMP evidence.
Result commitment and verified entitlement evidence must remain cross-consistent.
Refund evidence is accepted only from the bound canonical CMP job and settlement adapter.
Retained AI compatibility, hardening, model-rights, mature V1 and rewards suites remain green.
